rule: Salt-bloom in winter slows the burn
texts: Whenever a Keeper adds salt-bloom to mire-essence in winter, that mire-essence burns slowly.
Whenever a Keeper mixes salt-bloom into mire-essence in winter, that mire-essence burns slowly.
When a cold wind strikes a salt-bloomed lantern, the lantern stays lit.

fields.sentence: Whenever a Keeper adds salt-bloom to mire-essence in winter, that mire-essence burns slowly.
parse: (: whenever_saltbloom_burn (Implication (And (Member $a add) (Agent $a $k) (Member $k keeper) (Theme $a salt_bloom) (Goal $a $m) (Member $m mire_essence) (Time $a winter)) (And (Member (sk_burn $a) burn) (Patient (sk_burn $a) $m) (Manner (sk_burn $a) slowly) (During (sk_burn $a) $a))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: No decomposition atoms are emitted for the two compound kinds the parse coins: `(Inheritance salt_bloom bloom)` and `(Inheritance mire_essence essence)` are both required by Compound concepts (head genus always emitted; the noun modifiers `salt`/`mire` correctly stay unexposed), and Compound concepts states the emission is determined, not optional.

review.notes: Whenever machinery is applied correctly: plain-variable premises, Skolem-function consequent event, During link, no tense, no QuantifierPhrase companion, and 'that mire-essence' bound back to the premise variable $m (donkey anaphora). Goal for the non-animate 'to mire-essence', Theme for the applied substance, Patient for the intransitive change-of-state 'burns', and the surface-form Manner adverb `slowly` all match the role tests.

issues.reason: Compound concepts: a hyphenated modifier+head compound kind always emits its head genus ('the genus itself is always emitted either way'; emission is determined, not optional), so `(Inheritance salt_bloom bloom)` and `(Inheritance mire_essence essence)` are mandatory and their absence violates a stated rule (the noun modifiers `salt`/`mire` correctly stay unexposed).

new_gaps: A season as a time slot ('in winter'): the structured Time terms are Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour/Minute only and seasons appear solely as deictic constants (last_spring, next_summer), so a bare `(Time $a winter)` in a generic rule is improvised.
The inanimate destination of 'add X to Y': the instruction set does not settle Goal versus Recipient for a non-addressee 'to'-phrase on a transfer verb.
adjudication.defect_summary: Add `(: sb_genus (Inheritance salt_bloom bloom) (STV 1.0 0.99))` and `(: me_genus (Inheritance mire_essence essence) (STV 1.0 0.99))`; the whenever rule itself — plain-variable premises, Skolem consequent event with `During`, $m bound for 'that mire-essence', Theme/Goal/Patient roles, surface-form Manner `slowly`, no companion, (STV 1.0 0.9) — stands as emitted.

fields.sentence: Whenever a Keeper mixes salt-bloom into mire-essence in winter, that mire-essence burns slowly.
parse: (: whenever_mix_burn (Implication (And (Member $x mix) (Agent $x $k) (Member $k keeper) (Theme $x salt_bloom) (Goal $x mire_essence) (Time $x winter)) (And (Member (sk_burn $x) burn) (Patient (sk_burn $x) mire_essence) (Manner (sk_burn $x) slowly) (During (sk_burn $x) $x))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q2_gaps: A demonstrative anaphor picking out a specific portion of a mass noun that was introduced as a bare kind filler inside a rule ('mixes salt-bloom into mire-essence ... that mire-essence burns'): the bare-kind-filler rule for non-specific mass objects and the 'coreference is symbol reuse' rule together leave the anaphor as the kind symbol, so the consequent predicates burning of mire-essence-the-kind rather than the portion mixed; the instruction set never says whether such a mass participant may instead be individuated as a plain premise variable
review.notes: Whenever-machinery shape, per-occurrence Skolem consequent, During link, no QuantifierPhrase, and the 1.0/0.9 rule TV all match the instruction set; 'into' correctly takes the motion-result Goal with the moved substance as Theme, and 'in winter' as a bare named-time symbol on Time is licensed.

fields.sentence: When a cold wind strikes a salt-bloomed lantern, the lantern stays lit.
parse: (: strike_stay_lit_rule (Implication (And (Member $s strike) (Agent $s $w) (Theme $s $l) (Member $w wind) (Member $w cold) (Member $l lantern) (Member $l salt_bloomed)) (And (Member (sk_lit $s) lit) (Experiencer (sk_lit $s) $l) (Still (sk_lit $s)) (Member $l lit) (During (sk_lit $s) $s))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

review.notes: 'When P, Q' with indefinite participants correctly routes to the whenever machinery, and 'stays lit' gets the mandated continuation-copular shape - reified state, Experiencer, Still, plus the flat atom, with no Result link. 'strikes' taking Theme follows the does-the-object-change test and its default-to-Theme fallback.
